title: ConnectedDrive Store purchases and one dealer store mention
summary: This topic mixes ConnectedDrive Store feature-purchase mentions with a separate positive comment about a dealership store, so the examples do not form a single coherent issue.

limitations: The topic cluster mixes unrelated subjects: dealership store experience, ConnectedDrive Store digital purchases, and a system content-storage description.
